research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: frozen occupation extract, official APH/party biography, first speech, public professional index, historical Queensland minister diary, Tasmanian Estimates attendance, MTAA annual report, AMCHAM directory, Scottish Enterprise announcement, ARN interview and Broadcom acquisition record. Roster unchanged.

Private corporate government-affairs work is not political staff merely because it involves government; TCCI and MTAA are employer associations excluded under the codebook. Giddings and Winter office employment is political staff.

No substantive full-time designation found for any dated role. Cadetship/study and MBA overlaps need hours and leave evidence. Senior titles do not prove full-time status. Need 2019–20 interval and 2024–25 political-office boundaries.

Companies House historical Faraday filings identified at https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/10360764/filing-history?page=2; persons-with-significant-control page returned Internal Error without code. Historical control left unknown; government-funded trade mission not evidence of government control.

November 2024 Australian reporting indexed Meta departure June and return to Hobart in August for Winter in Mercury reporting; no complete accessible primary appointment document established those dates. Preserve as follow-up leads. Winter employment itself corroborated in accessible December analysis.
Do not confuse UK VMware vExpert Rich Dowling/virtRich, a Sydney Kong customer-experience professional, Irish politician, radiologist or pianist with this senator. No personal contacts collected.

Follow-up: Treasury cadet/analyst hours and transition, dated employer professional history, KFC legal employer, company control/contract details, exact private role endpoints, 2019–20 and 2024–25 gaps, study/campaign leave. Government and employer primary records may refine boundaries; totals remain unknown.

Follow-up2026-10-02: fellow cadet Dean Winter parliamentary testimony adds individual-linked program evidence of full-time cadet work/part-time study. Cadet component recorded separately without invented dates or double-counting2002–2007aggregate. Analyst component and leave remain unresolved.

Faraday historical Companies House index and primary Amp investment release examined; underlying2017accounts and2018confirmation statement failed with500redirect errors labelled non-retryable, not retried. Private investors identified, but full2017–2019control not proven. Targeted2019–2020and Winter/Meta transition searches did not resolve dates. Earlier statement that no full-time designation was found is superseded only for the undated cadet component.

Follow-up 2026-10-04: the publicly indexed professional profile now exposes July 2002–April 2007 for the Tasmanian Treasury Policy Analyst entry, narrowing the aggregate Treasury interval without inventing the cadet-to-analyst transition. Targeted searches did not independently resolve the exact Faraday-to-VMware gap, private-role hours/leave, Meta endpoints or Winter-office end. A direct profile fetch returned status 999; only the search-indexed profile text was used.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Contemporary5November2024William Bowe account, summarising identified Australian reporter Matthew Denholm, establishes Winter adviser role already held and Meta role already former by that observation. This moves the available transition evidence earlier than2December without inventing month endpoints or back-calculating five-month duration. Data-broker November2024–May2025claim not adopted; unrelated SEC ownership tables and namesakes not attributed. Need dated personal/employer appointment, hours/leave and Treasury cadet component boundaries to support totals.

Follow-up 2026-10-05: tested the queued Susan Bailey Mercury/Herald Sun report. Public Mercury index independently exposes August Hobart return associated with Dean Winter work and a 15 October 2024 photo caption, but the actual publication timestamp/year is unverified. No August appointment or June Meta cessation encoded, no five-month back-calculation. Reader No Cookies redirect and inaccessible syndicated URL are source-level limitations. Exact-date searches returned unrelated namesakes or generic Meta pages, not corroborating personal records. Lead preserved with URL/locator/access notes; Treasury cadet dates, private hours/leave, Faraday control and 2019–20 gap remain unresolved.
